tasks.label: RustPLC: project-check
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- project-check rustplc.bundle.toml --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --out-dir out/project_check/normal --output human

tasks.label: RustPLC: sim-plc
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- sim-plc rustplc.bundle.toml --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --out out/sim/normal/trace.jsonl

tasks.label: RustPLC: no-board-gate
tasks.command: cargo run --release --bin rust_plc -- no-board-gate rustplc.bundle.toml --scenario scenarios/nominal/normal.yaml --out-dir out/gate/no_board/normal --output human
